colors.name: ground
colors.role: the night — pure black ground; the page is a dark room, not a screen

colors.name: block
colors.role: white blocks / panels that carry black type — 21:1 black-on-white, 21:1 white-on-black

colors.name: strobe
colors.role: electric blue — the ONE accent. Display/large text on black measures 4.35:1 (passes AA 3:1 large); carries black type at 4.35:1 large; white on it reaches 4.83:1 (AA body). Used for wordmark plates, ticket CTA, marquee row B, scanline tint

colors.name: ash
colors.role: secondary metadata on black — 4.6:1 (AA body). Never the headline, always the timestamp/venue note that sits below it

fonts.role: every Hangul glyph — a single 400 weight that reads as a solid block; the wordmark and the section titles in Korean
Latin display — wordmark, section titles, the footer shout. Stacked after Black Han Sans so Latin falls through to a matching heavy slab
timestamps, BPM, ticket ledger, venue co-ordinates — monospace keeps the schedule tabular without a table

texture: Two layers, both CSS. (1) A pointer-transparent fixed overlay of repeating horizontal scanlines at 3px pitch drawn with repeating-linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), gated to the hero only and to reduced-motion-off. (2) The strobe: a 2.6s opacity pulse on the wordmark's blue plate (1.0 → 0.55), dead under reduced motion and without JS. No feTurbulence, no image — the texture is the light, not the paper.

motion.name: marquee-fast
motion.value: 0.20 px/ms (~200 px/s) — the headliner ticker, left

motion.name: marquee-mid
motion.value: 0.12 px/ms (~120 px/s) — the opener ticker, right

motion.name: marquee-slow
motion.value: 0.07 px/ms (~70 px/s) — the genre ticket, left

motion.name: strobe
motion.value: 2.6s ease-in-out infinite, opacity 1 → 0.55 — the wordmark blue plate breathes

motion.name: scanline-drift
motion.value: linear 8s infinite, translate3d(0, 3px, 0) — the 3px-pitch grid slides one line per cycle

motion.name: reveal-cut
motion.value: clip-path inset/polygon 100%→0 over 620ms steps(8, end) — a hard geometric wipe, not a fade

motion.name: press-in
motion.value: 0ms — :active snaps translate(8px,8px), shadow collapses to 0 (anti-easing, same doctrine as blunt at a harder 8px)
